meta.name: infra-postgres
meta.description: Sets up and manages Postgres using the clickhousectl CLI — runs a local Docker-backed Postgres for development, and creates and operates managed ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services (connections, TLS, runtime config, read replicas, failover, point-in-time restore). Use when the user wants a Postgres or PostgreSQL database for their application, a local Postgres dev environment, psql access, or a managed/production Postgres in ClickHouse Cloud, or mentions moving a local Postgres to production.

copy.tagline: 快速搭建本地与云端的 Postgres 数据库环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速启动一个 Postgres 数据库用于开发或生产环境
copy.tagline_en: Quickly set up Postgres databases locally and in the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick Postgres database for development or production

howto.what: 通过 clickhousectl CLI 管理 Postgres：在本地用 Docker 运行开发实例，或在 ClickHouse Cloud 上创建托管服务（连接、TLS、配置、只读副本、故障转移、时间点恢复）。
howto.when: 当用户说“我要用 Postgres 数据库”、“需要一个 Postgres 开发环境”或“把本地 Postgres 搬到生产”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个本地 Postgres 开发数据库。
say.note: 会启动 Docker 容器，返回连接信息。

say.text: 在 ClickHouse Cloud 上创建一个托管 Postgres 服务。
say.note: 会按需配置并部署云端实例。

say.text: 给我的 Postgres 添加只读副本。
say.note: 会为现有云服务创建副本。

howto.what_en: Manages Postgres via clickhousectl CLI: runs local Docker-backed instances for development, and creates/manages ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services (connections, TLS, config, read replicas, failover, point-in-time restore).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a Postgres database, a local dev environment, psql access, a managed/production Postgres, or mentions moving local Postgres to production.

say_en.text: Create a local Postgres dev database for me.
say_en.note: Launches a Docker container and returns connection details.

say_en.text: Provision a managed Postgres service in ClickHouse Cloud.
say_en.note: Deploys a cloud instance with requested settings.

say_en.text: Add a read replica to my Postgres.
say_en.note: Creates a replica for an existing cloud service.
